issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'Bethel' (בֵּית אֵל) as the place sending the delegation, but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Nhà Ên-đô' (House of En-dor), which is a different place name. The Hebrew also has 'Sar-Ezer' (שַׂר אֶצֶר) and 'Regem-Melech' (רֶגֶם מֶלֶךְ) as the senders, but the Vietnamese gives 'Sê-rê-xe' and 'Rê-gem-mê-léc' — the first name appears to be a transliteration mismatch (Sar-Ezer vs. Sê-rê-xe), and the second is close but the overall place name is wrong.
